104-2034-3490-8319.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2034-3490-8319.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1479-1659-2841-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-1659-2841-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Seed the Land trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

413-1308-4559-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
413-1308-4559-7839.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2034-2073-2829-7880.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Elven Bow from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Elven Bow enters, it triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token and attach Elven Bow to it.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Elven Bow.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elf Warrior dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

1477-2073-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
1477-2073-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

215-1902-7060.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-7060.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

394-3240-5147-6462.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

483-4496-5220-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-3845-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

7-7182-7252.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-7182-7252.description:
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Hamza.
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1409-2307-2499.description:
Activate Corsair Captain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Corsair Captain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Corsair Captain.
Resolve both Corsair Captain triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2060-4770-4924-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

141-5231-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5231-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

1012-5220-5231.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {R} or less.
1012-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1315-1850-6850.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1315-1850-6850.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

539-5231-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-2972-6693.description:
Cast Ganax either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Ganax enters the battlefield, it, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Sarkhan trigger. 
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Ganax.
Resolve the Sarkhan trigger, causing it to become a copy of Ganax whose name is still Sarkhan, Soul Aflame until end of turn.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Ganax by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ganax enters the battlefield, it, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Sarkhan trigger.
Resolve the Ganax and Sarkhan triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Ganax.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 7.

3941-4067-6281-6435.easyPrerequisites: There are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
3941-4067-6281-6435.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Coati Scavenger.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Coati Scavenger that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Coati Scavenger token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coati Scavenger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

880-2907-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2907-4871.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers, creating that many creature token(s).
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1413-2034-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thraben Doomsayer does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Thraben Doomsayer.
1413-2034-2178.description:
Activate Thraben Doomsayer by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Human, adding {C}{C}.
When the Human dies, Thraben Doomsayer triggers, untapping Thraben Doomsayer.
Repeat.

495-500-3000-4688-4751.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Nested Shambler.
495-500-3000-4688-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time, as well as two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting eight +1/+1 counters on Nested Shambler.
Kill Nested Shambler, triggering its ability, creating at least 18 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

1651-1737-4715-4772.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Prized Statue.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures and/or Prized Statue tokens, untapping Prototype Portal.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

549-1808-4659-5267.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {2}.
Eloise's and Ulvenwald Mysteries' second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Eloise trigger, surveilling 1.
Resolve the Ulvenwald Mysteries trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Human Soldier, adding {2}.
Eloise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve Eloise's first trigger, causing you to investigate.
 Resolve Eloise's second trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

678-1322-1402.description:
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
Diamond Lion dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
Repeat.
